text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of Yaeno Muteki's debut race. I find myself awake early and decide to go on a walk to ease my nerves.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
choice_data_list: I thought I recognized your voice.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
choice_data_list: You're practicing your katas so early today.
You're practicing your katas so early today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes. Today is the day of my all-important debut, so I'm taking more care than usual to temper my fiery emotions.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I intend to contain these flames within until the decisive moment, whereupon I shall unleash them in full force.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I was reviewing my race strategy while practicing the Yaegaki katas.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I was worried she might be too fired up for her race, but it seems my worries were misplaced. She has her competitive spirit in check for now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki, from deep concentration, suddenly breaks the silence.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The days where I must engage many opponents in battle draw near… The mere thought sets my blood on fire.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Fear not. I have a firm hold on both our race strategy and how to handle the blaze fierce with the stillness of water.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I intend to pour my whole being into exemplifying my school's technique in my debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki's every word swells with eagerness, but she seems perfectly composed and in control of her competitive drive.
